interpretation: CSV contains observer output angular rates but no raw payload rotation. These residuals include real swing, observer dynamics and finite-window spectral leakage; they are not measured NOKOV angle noise.

suggested_repeatable_stress_test.inject: Measured payload orientation only, before real observer callback; no direct body-rate noise. Keep physical truth unchanged.
suggested_repeatable_stress_test.rough_linear_observer_relation: For alpha=.35, angular_rate_gain=.30, dt=.01, unit white angle noise gives rate std~41.60 and >8Hz std~38.45 rad/s per rad. Suggested angles are only a sensitivity envelope.
